text: Nice, do blockbench like defaults and tune control
resolution: Built the Studio viewport (editors/model/Studio.tsx — StudioViewport/StudioRoute) with Blockbench-like defaults and tuning control, wired as a STUDIO workbench tab (editors/workbench/model/source.tsx + one line in sources.ts). It renders the cuboid EditMesh via Scene3D's dynamic-geometry path (live verts, no rebuild) on a 1m ground grid + origin axes, with the HOST-OWNED orbit camera driven through GAME_NATIVE_CAMERA.forNode (setOrbit/setInputDeltas — framework/game/camera.zig's orbit Controller, the same host camera the compiled no-JS path uses), Blockbench-ish 3/4 boot framing, an fov knob + reframe, and a registered STUDIO P2 tunables table at /model (grid extent, boot yaw/pitch, fov, orbit sensitivity, fit distance) for live tuning. Verified by bundling: editMesh 9/9 headless, Studio.tsx and the full workbench sources.ts chain bundle clean. Solid mode only; hot-reloadable with no framework rebuild. Wireframe + the editing gutters (outliner/add-mesh/transform/selection/gizmo) are the next increments. Pending the user's eyeball on camera feel + grid scale to tune.
